stemMarkdown: In a race of 600 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 9:4. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 600 m, B covers $\dfrac{4}{9} \times 600 = 266.67$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 600 - 266.67 = 333.33$ m.
